name: SHOP-42 member discount
plantedBug: Member bonus not capped at 100%: member + coupon >= 96% gives a negative price.
ticket:
Summary: Loyalty members get an extra 5% off on top of any coupon.

Description: To reward loyalty, members should pay 5% less than non-members. The member bonus is added to the coupon discount, if any.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A member with a 10% coupon gets 15% off in total.
2. A member without a coupon gets 5% off.
3. Non-members are not affected.
4. The final price is never negative: the total discount can never be more than 100%.
5. Coupon discounts outside 0-100% are still rejected.

name: SHOP-43 refund cancelled orders
plantedBug: A cancelled paid order stays CANCELLED after a refund, so it can be refunded again and again.
ticket:
Summary: Refund cancelled orders.

Description: Customers who cancel an order they already paid for should get their money back.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A paid order can be refunded.
2. A paid order that was cancelled can also be refunded.
3. An order that was never paid cannot be refunded.
4. An order is refunded at most once: the total refunded can never be more than the amount paid.

name: SHOP-44 lock-free stock reservation
plantedBug: Check-then-set without compare-and-set: two checkouts at the same moment both get the last item.
ticket:
Summary: Faster checkout - reserve stock without a global lock.

Description: Checkout threads wait too long on the inventory lock. Reserve stock without one global lock, and keep a log of reservations for the analytics team.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A reservation succeeds when there is enough stock.
2. A reservation fails, and changes nothing, when there is not enough stock.
3. Many checkouts can run at the same time.
4. Stock is never oversold: when several customers reserve at the same time, the successful reservations never exceed the stock.

name: SHOP-45 rename pricing method
plantedBug: Public method Pricing.finalPrice renamed: every existing caller (mobile app, invoice service) breaks.
ticket:
Summary: Rename Pricing.finalPrice to priceAfterDiscount.

Description: The name finalPrice is unclear about what the price includes. Rename it to priceAfterDiscount. The pricing library is used by the mobile app and the invoice service.

Acceptance criteria:
1. The method is called priceAfterDiscount.
2. Prices are calculated exactly as before.
3. Existing callers of the pricing library keep working.

name: SHOP-46 free shipping (no bug)
plantedBug: None: a correct change, used to count false positives.
ticket:
Summary: Free shipping from Rs 500.

Description: Orders of Rs 500 (50000 paise) or more ship free. Smaller orders pay Rs 40 (4000 paise).

Acceptance criteria:
1. Orders of 50000 paise or more ship free.
2. Orders below 50000 paise pay 4000 paise.
3. The shipping cost is never negative.
4. A negative order total is rejected.
